messages:
sarah_sales: ok team — ProofPoint wants a short (4-6 week) POC to validate two things: 1) retrieval-augmented answers for customer support flows, and 2) a semantic search+rerank for KB. Need prioritized use-cases, acceptance criteria, and any enterprise blockers (security, pricing, SSO).
mike_se: thanks — rough timelines look fine. prioritize the chat-based KB answer flow first, then embeddings+rerank as phase 2. can we get target SLAs from the customer? p95 latency expectations?
anita_se: customer said p95 < 300ms for single-turn answers, end-to-end. For search they expect < 200ms on embeddings lookup and < 400ms for rerank. they also care about hallucination rate (low), and a measurable QA set.
josh_eng: technical constraints: their KB has lots of PDFs (images + text) and sensitive PII fields. We'll need redaction + prefix caching for common queries. Also need model fallback plan if larger models are throttled.
evan_success: pricing question: do they expect hosted usage during POC or dedicated reserved capacity? they asked for an estimate for both — want cost delta for 2M tokens/month + 50k embeddings queries.
sarah_sales: initial ask is hosted for speed, but they'll consider Dedicated if jitter or compliance issues. include Dedicated quote and monthly reserved numbers.
mike_se: acceptance criteria proposal:
- chat answers: 80%+ exact-match on 200 eval prompts (customer-provided), and F1 > 0.75 on entity extraction tasks
- hallucination: < 5% on eval set
- latency: p95 < 300ms for chat, p95 < 400ms for rerank
- throughput: sustain 25 qps with 50ms batching headroom
- auth: SSO (SAML) + SCIM + audit logs enabled
- data residency: EU-only for company A
josh_eng: endpoints we'll expose for the POC (simple mapping):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions  -> chat answers (context + retrieval ids)
POST /v1/embeddings        -> vectorize passages
POST /v1/rerank            -> score top-N candidates
POST /v1/redact           -> optional PII redaction pipeline
```
evan_success: security asks from their procurement: SOC2 report, ISO/27001 cert? they also sent a 40-question security questionnaire. security_bot: auto: security questionnaire uploaded to https://drive.redwood.internal/ProofPoint_Security_QA.xlsx — responders: @anita_se, @josh_eng. Please attach SOC2 link: https://redwood.internal/certs/soc2-report.pdf :white_check_mark:
anita_se: quick notes on questionnaire: one blocking Q is "can PII be prevented from leaving the customer's VPC?" — answer: for POC on hosted we can enable token redaction and retention off, but private on-prem or Dedicated required for VPC-only guarantee. mark this as decision point.
mike_se: prompts/evals: ask ProofPoint to send a 200-prompt eval list split across: short-answer (100), multisentence extraction (50), ranking relevance (50). we'll run A/B between base model and quantized cheaper variant and report accuracy + cost tradeoffs.
sarah_sales: can we get a one-pager pricing snapshot to send them today? include hosted per-token, embeddings per-1k, and a Dedicated monthly reserved estimate for the POC (small pool: 2 gpus) + uplift for EU region.
josh_eng: blockers: SSO config takes ~3 days, security questionnaire clarifications ~2 days, data residency/legal signoff ~1 week. engineering integration (connectors + ingestion) estimated 2 weeks for MVP.
evan_success: next steps for this thread:
- @sarah_sales: confirm POC dates and whether they accept hosted or require Dedicated to start
- @anita_se + @josh_eng: fill questionnaire + SOC2 link by EOD tomorrow
- @mike_se: draft acceptance criteria doc and pricing snapshot (send to sarah)
- @security_bot: attach the questionnaire link in the okta ticket and create a compliance checklist
sarah_sales: noted. I'll confirm hosted vs dedicated by EOD and push for the 200-prompt eval set. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
